text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives member of the ruling family in Qatar who carries the emir's greetings to his excellency.
- Saddam receives former Jordanian information minister Hani al-Khasawna.
- French spokesman confirms differences with Washington over sanctions on Iraq.
- National Assembly observes week of solidarity with Iraqi POWs still held in Iran.
- Iraqi trade minister discusses with his Egyptian counterpart Iraqi imports of food and medicine from Egypt.
- French ship loaded with wheat on its way to Iraq.
- Article on the reasons behind aggression on sisterly Sudan.
- Editorial on the necessity of adhering to economic guidelines Saddam set last year to improve Iraqi economy.
